notes.title: ✨ Demo Polished, Cloud Saves Added, Ready for Magic!
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone,[/p][p]Over the past few weeks I’ve been focused on polishing the whole Catjinni Survivors experience and it’s come a long way! The game now [b]looks and sounds better than ever[/b].[/p][p]Here are some highlights from the new build:[/p][list][*][p]🌫️ [b]New Fog Effects[/b] – Furlin’s Castle is now shrouded in an extra-mystical, misty atmosphere.[/p][/*][*][p]🎨 [b]Improved Visuals[/b] – several shaders have been reworked to give enemies and the world a sharper, more unique look.[/p][/*][*][p]☁️ [b]Cloud Saves[/b] – your progress is now safe in the Steam Cloud and ready to follow you anywhere.[/p][/*][/list][p]If you run into any problems or bugs, please share them on the [b]discussion board[/b], your feedback is super valuable and appreciated![/p][p]I’m really excited to finally get this polished version into your hands and can’t wait to hear what you think![/p][p][/p][p]Best wishes,[/p][p]Niel
[/p]

notes.title: Catjinni Survivors Demo Update
notes.content: [p][b]This update brings:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Enhanced Graphics & Performance: enjoy sharper visuals and smoother gameplay[/p][/*][*][p]Immersive Audio: improved sounds and full 3D audio effects[/p][/*][*][p]New Intro Scene & Night Music: seamless loading & fresh atmospheric tracks[/p][/*][*][p]Upgraded Enemies: better shaders[/p][/*][*][p]Gameplay Improvements: upgrades from lamps now paus after displaying the result[/p][/*][*][p]Refined UI & UX: new animated interface background[/p][/*][*][p]Balanced Gameplay: fairer challenges and improved sidequests[/p][/*][*][p]Dash Meter & Haptics: track dashes easily and feel every action with enhanced feedback[/p][/*][*][p]Localization: updated texts and translations for multiple languages[/p][/*][/list][p]Jump back in, survive the chaos, and let us know how you like the new features, right here or on Discord![/p]

notes.title: 🎉 1,001 Wishlists! You’re all amazing, thank you so much!
notes.content: [p][b]1,001 Wishlists – Thank You![/b][/p][p]Thank you to everyone supporting [i]Catjinni Survivors[/i].[/p][p]And it hasn’t even been 1,001 nights yet. ːsteamhappyː[/p][p]I’ve been working on major changes and gathering playtesting feedback and so far, things are going very well.[/p][p]This is just the beginning. I’m continuing to improve the game and experiment based on your ideas and input. Got suggestions or feedback? Drop them in the comments or join the Discord. I read everything.[/p][p]Thanks again.[/p][p][/p][p] Francis, Sushi, Fluppy and Flocki would be proud. [/p]

notes.title: Catjinni Survivors Livestream
notes.content: [p]Watch a recording of the developer playing Catjinni Survivors. Grow stronger by day, survive the night. A brutally charming survivor-like roguelite in which you unleash the power of the Catjinn gods to defeat Ifrit’s hordes. Face mighty bosses and shape your build. Every run is unique, every run counts. With optional VR support and playable on the Steam Deck! Try it now! [/p]

notes.title: Demo Update: A Fresh Layer of Polish
notes.content: [p][b]Demo Update:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Redesigned [i]Cheops[/i] to be wider and more detailed, with additional plant life and improved layout.[/p][/*][*][p]Added enhanced haptic effects for increased immersion and tactile feedback.[/p][/*][*][p]Introduced several new weapons and skills to discover and experiment with.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved various sound effects for a more dynamic audio experience.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug that caused the menu to remain selected after exiting.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved an issue where the character backstory scroll window could appear empty.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where unlocked achievements were incorrectly highlighted again when re-entering the menu.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]I’d love to hear what you think, your feedback helps shape the next steps![/p]

notes.title: Steam Deck Compatibility
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone![/p][p]I'm Niel, the solo developer behind [b]Catjinni Survivors[/b]. From day one, I've been building this game with the [b]Steam Deck[/b] in mind — because like many of you, I’m a huge fan of portable gaming.[/p][p]The Steam Deck has been my favorite way to play since its launch, and I’ve worked hard to make sure [b]Catjinni Survivors[/b] feels great on it — with smooth performance, readable UI, and controls that just [i]feel right[/i] in your hands.[/p][p]If you’re playing on Deck, I hope you’ll love the experience as much as I’ve loved crafting it.[/p][p]Thanks for the support — and happy surviving! [/p][p]Niel[/p]

notes.title: Demo Update – Progression Fixes, New Boss, Balance Improvements & More
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone,[/p][p]I’ve just updated the demo with several important changes, improvements, and fixes based on internal testing and player feedback. Here’s what’s new:

[b]Major Changes[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Progression Fix[/b]: Level-ups now trigger correctly and consistently.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New First Boss[/b]: The first boss has been changed from Arakne to the [b]Maneater Boss[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Enemy Added[/b]: Introduced a new standard enemy in Cheops – [b]the Wild Boar[/b]. It’s faster than mummies but still goes down in one or two hits.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Cheops Level Layout Updated[/b]: The level has been made wider to improve movement and combat flow.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Balance & Gameplay[/h3][list][*][p][b]Luck Rework[/b]: Luck is no longer scaled in flat 1%–10% steps. It now influences XP and heart drop rates in a more balanced way.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Upgrades Added[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]One upgrade reduces the duration of [b]night[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]One upgrade reduces the duration of [b]day[/b].[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Lighting Adjustment[/b]: The [b]night phase[/b] is now brighter for better visibility.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Bug Fixes & Optimization[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed several issues with enemy interactions during [b]dashing[/b], especially cases where enemies would behave unpredictably.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved code performance across the board for better overall gameplay smoothness.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]This update also includes various smaller fixes and tweaks not listed here. I'll continuing to fine-tune the demo, and your feedback is incredibly valuable![/p][p]Try the updated demo and let me know what you think![/p][p]Thank you for playing and supporting the project.[/p]
